This file records **QPB's own run-layout invariants for this run** — where the playbook

For the Express product specification, see [`REQUIREMENTS.md`](REQUIREMENTS.md). Both files

## Artifact layout

These REQs convert artifact-location compliance into testable requirements so the Phase 6
gate and human reviewers have concrete REQs to enforce against. They constrain the
playbook's own output layout for this run.

### REQ-009: Per-bug writeup placement at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md
- Tier: 3
- References: quality/writeups/
- Conditions of satisfaction: every confirmed `BUG-<id>` has a writeup at `quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md`.
- Specificity: architectural-guidance

### REQ-016: Prohibition on quality/workspace/<name>/ in favor of top-level quality/<name>/
- Tier: 3
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: no `quality/workspace/` directory exists at any point in the run (populated OR empty); all artifacts use top-level `quality/<name>/` paths. The Phase 6 gate's `check_no_workspace_dir` enforces this mechanically.
- Specificity: architectural-guidance
